review_basis: Direct inspection of the three original-resolution r33 PNG boards after recursive geometry synthesis, joint scope/phenotype selection, and same-source legal/FAR/parking evaluation.

neighborhood.measured: 20/20, 20 BOOK principles, 16 visual languages, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate pairs; curved 4, oblique 1, prismatic 6, stepped 2, voided 5, winged 2.
neighborhood.visual_verdict: Courtyard, curve, branch, notch, stepped and oblique alternatives coexist, but several low prismatic/chamfer bodies retain a shared generic family.
neighborhood.remaining_limit: Street frontage, tenant subdivision, vertical circulation and public-ground section are not resolved.

gymnasium.measured: 20/20, 18 BOOK principles, 19 visual languages, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate pairs; curved 1, oblique 2, prismatic 6, stepped 4, voided 2, winged 5.
gymnasium.visual_verdict: The earlier gable-only drift is gone and winged, stepped, court, saw-cut and oblique halls coexist; some long bars still read as generic clipped sheds in isometric view.
gymnasium.remaining_limit: Clear-span structure, roof daylight, entry/service circulation and spectator section remain unverified.

cultural.measured: 20/20, 19 BOOK principles, 16 visual languages, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate pairs; curved 2, oblique 1, prismatic 6, stepped 5, voided 3, winged 3.
cultural.visual_verdict: Courtyard, paired gallery, curve, step and notch moves are present, but several low chamfer/terrace bodies remain too close to the neighborhood vocabulary.
cultural.remaining_limit: Gallery sequence, art logistics, civic entry hierarchy and daylight section remain unresolved.

verdict: The extended CSG program, BOOK scope, clean-mass gate, and legal/parking pipeline now produce a reproducible 60/60 procedurally diverse portfolio. Direct image review still finds cross-program low-box/chamfer/terrace family resemblance, so competition-grade completion is explicitly rejected. A rotated live VLM credential is required to run the newly closed ArchDaily-reference and graph-memory typed-edit loop on the real PNU rather than only through the causal test double.
